data.title: Lockbox Master key | Dungeon Defenders II Wiki | Fandom
data.description: Master key's can be purchased at the Treasure Pirate for ?? Gems or 500 Defender Medals. Master keys are used to open obtainable Lockboxes which can be drop from mini-bosses. Upon opening a Lockbox the player obtains a random cosmetic item of that class.

data.title: Victory Chests | Dungeon Defenders II Wiki | Fandom
data.description: These chests appear after you have defeated all waves in a map and reward you with bonus loot. There are four different rarities of chests: Powerful (Green), Epic (Blue), Mythical (Purple), and Legendary (Orange). data.title: Version/20.3 - Dungeon Defenders II Wiki
data.description: All individual Lockbox Master Keys purchased from the shop with gems can now properly open lockboxes. All Lockbox Master Keys properly stack now. Fixed level geometry issues on Greystone Plaza. Fixed a bug that stopped players from being unable to purchase the Five Pack of Hero Cards with Defender Medals.
